content_sections.text: CONCOR has announced vacancies for Management Trainee and Assistant Officer posts in various disciplines. The post-wise vacancy details are given below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates having the required educational qualifications can apply for different posts. The eligibility details are as per the post requirements mentioned in the official notification. Management Trainee Posts: Candidates with relevant qualifications in Engineering, Management, Accounts, Finance, Technical and other required disciplines. Assistant Officer Posts: Candidates with relevant graduation / professional qualifications as required for the respective discipline.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CONCOR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official CONCOR website. Open the Recruitment section. Read the official notification carefully. Click on the online application link. Register using your required details. Fill out the application form with correct information. Upload required documents and photographs. Submit the application form before the last date. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the organisation conducting CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR) is conducting the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are released under CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 77 vacancies have been announced for Management Trainee and Assistant Officer posts.

faq.question: Q3. What posts are available in CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Management Trainee (C&O, Accounts, Accounts/Compliance, Technical, MIS, Civil, P&A) and Assistant Officer (C&O, Accounts, Technical, MIS, Civil).

faq.question: Q4. What is the starting date to apply online for CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process will start from 31 August 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for CONCOR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 30 September 2026 up to 11:55 PM.
